name: com.weshoal/tools
title: WeShoal — free browser tools finder
description: Find free WeShoal browser tools (PDF, image, audio, video, QR), AI prices, and UK VAT calculators.

tools.name: list_free_browser_tools
tools.description: Find the WeShoal web tool that does a task (e.g. "compress a PDF to 200 KB", "remove vocals from a song", "HEIC to JPG", "UK VAT"). Returns tool names, direct URLs and whether it runs free in the browser or uses paid cloud AI. Most tools are free, need no sign-up and keep files on the device.

task_query.description: What the user wants to do, in plain words.

tools.name: get_tool_details
tools.description: Get the description, how-to steps, FAQs, price model and URL of one WeShoal tool by its slug (the last part of its URL, e.g. "merge-pdf").

tools.name: list_ai_tools_and_prices
tools.description: List WeShoal's pay-per-run cloud AI tools with their fixed prices in GBP pence. No subscription or account: one free try per tool, then prepaid credit from £3.

tools.name: calculate_uk_vat
tools.description: Add VAT to a net amount or remove VAT from a gross amount. Default rate 20% (UK standard); 5% and 0% are the UK reduced and zero rates.

mode.description: "add" = amount is net (ex VAT); "remove" = amount is gross (inc VAT).

tools.name: calculate_percentage_change
tools.description: Percentage increase or decrease from one value to another.
